fields: h, intro, cols, rows [[method, how, fit, trade-off]], anchor, figs [name per row: "chemical", "hot", "uv"], scale {row, marks [{v, l}]} (the temperature figure: marks in °C along a 0–100 rail), absent (the missing method's name, shown large in outline on the dashed tile with the intro). scale.base: the reading below the first mark (motion.js turns the rail into a probe the visitor can drag along it, with detents at the marks).
